findings.message: Replacing the hasOwnProperty prototype-safe own-key check with `cache[key] || fallback` is incorrect on two counts: (1) falsy cached values (false, 0, "", null) are silently discarded and replaced with fallback, violating the stated requirement; (2) it removes the own-property guard, so inherited/prototype properties and prototype-pollution keys can be returned as if cached. Also, `cache[key]` will throw if `cache` is null/undefined, whereas the original would too actually—but the main regressions are the falsy-value and own-key issues.
